purpose: phase8_batch_v9 with evidence_adequacy 1.1.0 so PMC tables travel on PaperDocument. Extraction routes, aggregation, tolerances and TableCapture are unchanged from v9; a difference versus a v9 run is attributable to the table-aware document plus missing_source classification.
why_routed: Values are still read in batches and arm identities one at a time, unchanged from v9. What changes is the document the extractor is handed: parsed PMC tables sit beside full_text.
why_v10: Contract 13. evidence_adequacy 1.0.0 cannot hash-match a tree whose PaperDocument carries tables. This profile pins 1.1.0. Extraction prompt contracts are unchanged (P5 is a later profile). Historical runs under 1.0.0 are not directly comparable, by design: accuracy of the gate input outranks byte-reproducibility of the old hash.
